corrections.summary: Removed the unsupported Azure discovery and mitigation dates and scoped its guidance to affected Classic tiers. Added NSM, Mandiant, and the earlier Broadcom advisory. Separated action urgency from patch availability, corrected KEV unknown states, and mapped fixes to their components and CVEs. Historical scores retain their original attribution; unavailable score dates remain unknown.

Scoped exploitation labels to individual CVEs. For Chrome, exploitation is confirmed for CVE-2026-125350, which was fixed in an earlier release, and not established for the new sandbox escape CVE-2026-134401. For vCenter, exploitation is confirmed for CVE-2026-123890 and not established for CVE-2026-123903. Recommended actions and urgency are unchanged.

items.priority_reason: The current desktop release includes an exploited vulnerability fix and addresses a critical sandbox escape.
items.summary: The desktop update addresses CVE-2026-134401, a sandbox escape not known to be exploited in this edition, and includes the earlier fix for exploited CVE-2026-125350. Chrome updates do not update Chromium embedded in other applications; this edition does not establish which Electron applications are affected or fixed.
items.action: Update Chrome to 158.0.8127.88 on Linux, or 158.0.8127.88 or 158.0.8127.89 on Windows and macOS. Check the separate vendor advisories and update channels for applications that embed Chromium.

items.priority_reason: CISA KEV listing and potential site takeover require prompt action on affected installations.
items.affected: <10.6.22 || >=11.0.0 <11.3.22 || >=11.4.0 <11.4.13; unsupported release lines require migration to a supported branch.
items.summary: An installer weakness can allow a Drupal site takeover. Drupal rates the issue Highly critical, and CISA lists it as exploited. Unsupported release lines have no security fix.
items.action: Update to 10.6.22, 11.3.22, or 11.4.13. Lock down /core/install.php and keep settings.php unwritable. End-of-life lines have no fix.

items.priority_reason: An exploited vCenter vulnerability affects a privileged management plane; the current cumulative releases also address the newer authentication bypass.
items.summary: CVE-2026-123890 has reported exploitation and a recorded KEV addition on 20 November. The separate CVE-2026-123903 authentication bypass was disclosed on 24 November; exploitation of that newer issue is not established here. Broadcom lists cumulative updates and no workaround for the newer issue.
items.action: Apply the cumulative update for your supported branch: vCenter 9.1.2, 9.0.2.0300, or 8.0 U3m; use VCF 5.2.5 for the affected Cloud Foundation branch. Follow the applicable Broadcom response matrix and keep management access restricted.

items.priority_reason: Reported credential exposure requires rotation and investigation even after the provider has mitigated the service vulnerability.
items.affected: Affected Azure API Management Classic instances; NSM excludes V2 and Consumption tiers from this vulnerability guidance.
items.summary: NSM reports that attackers targeted APIM access tokens, secrets, and named values. Provider remediation does not remove the need to rotate exposed credentials. No CVE identifier is recorded in this edition.
items.action: For affected Classic instances, rotate tokens and secrets, review access logs and the data behind the gateway, and verify the service update using NSM guidance. Contact the provider if the instance is not updated.

items.priority_reason: A high-severity issue has available fixes; prioritize applications that pass untrusted data to these methods.
items.summary: Untrusted input passed to listRemote() or raw() can cause argument injection. Public proof-of-concept discussion has been reported; active exploitation is not established in this edition.
items.action: Update to simple-git 4.1.0 and @simple-git/argv-parser 3.0.0. Do not pass untrusted input to listRemote() or raw().

items.priority_reason: Observed exploitation and the absence of a maintained fix require replacement and investigation now.
items.affected: Idunno.AntiCsrf 0.9.1.0 / 0.9.1 Beta and customized builds retaining the vulnerable implementation.
items.summary: An abandoned ASP.NET anti-CSRF library has a remotely exploitable deserialization flaw. Mandiant reports active exploitation, and no official patch is available.
items.action: Replace Idunno.AntiCsrf with a supported anti-CSRF mechanism and investigate exposed applications for compromise. Follow Mandiant guidance when removing the component so request-forgery protection is retained.
